id: title:frankh:serve probes from a dedicated runtime thread

review.posthog_relevance: Provides a dedicated OS thread and event loop for readiness and liveness probes, preventing them from competing with ingestion workers. This could help avoid pod scheduling failures or readiness timeouts when the ingestion worker is saturated.
review.reason: Adds a dedicated management runtime and its own Tokio runtime, separate from the data-plane runtime, to serve health and metrics endpoints. This architectural change isolates the control-plane health checks from the ingestion workload, potentially improving system stability and availability during high-load ingestion scenarios.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on runtime contention and scheduling behavior not fully demonstrated in this hunk; no test results or production incident avoidance are shown.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete Rust change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed; score and confidence withheld.
